recipes.name: Babish’s Ultimate Fried Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole chicken, broken down into ten pieces
2 quarts frying fat of choice (high smoke point like refined peanut, lard, canola, vegetable)
instructions: Dry brine the chicken: combine all ingredients, whisking until homogenous. Sprinkle evenly over all the chicken pieces - refrigerate, uncovered, for at least 4 hours, up to 24. - 1 whole chicken broken down into ten pieces - ¼ cup kosher salt - ¼ tsp garlic powder - ¼ tsp onion powder - ¼ tsp white pepper - ¼ tsp celery salt - ¼ tsp sweet paprika - ¼ tsp ground mustard - ¼ tsp cayenne pepper - 2 tsp MSG
In a high-walled dutch oven, heat frying fat to 315° F. - 2 quarts frying fat of choice (high smoke point like refined peanut lard, canola, vegetable)

Make the batter and dredge: in a tall, narrow bowl, combine 75g flour, potato starch, and kosher salt - whisk until evenly distributed. Add buttermilk, egg white, vodka, and seltzer - gently fold together to combine until it resembles lumpy pancake batter. - 75 g all purpose flour divided - 50 g potato starch - ¼ tsp kosher salt - 100 g buttermilk - 30 g liquid egg whites - 25 g vodka - 120 g cold seltzer water

In a large, wide bowl, combine remaining flour, salt, and white rice flour - whisk until evenly distributed. Drizzle 2 tablespoons of batter into the dry ingredients and whisk, breaking into small pieces, for extra-crunchy chicken. - 300 g all purpose flour divided - 1 tsp kosher salt - 50 g white rice flour

1-2 pieces at a time, dip the chicken in the liquid batter, making sure every nook and/or cranny is evenly coated. Drop into the flour mixture, being careful not to touch the wet batter. Cover the pieces with flour and toss, pressing the mixture into the chicken, until generously coated with no wet patches.

Fry at 315° F for 5-7 minutes, until chicken pieces are lightly blonde, not browned. Remove from the oil and drain on a wire rack. Let cool for 30 minutes or refrigerate until ready to fry. Optional: strain oil between low-and-high-temp frying to prevent particulate from burning.

Increase fat temperature to 400° F and fry chicken again, for 2-4 minutes, until golden brown and cooked through (white meat 165° F dark meat 175°-185° F). Sprinkle with kosher salt while still hot and serve immediately. - kosher salt
